ruleDefinitions.name: INS: First-time eDiscovery content search by user
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user performs an eDiscovery content search (New-ComplianceSearch, Start-ComplianceSearch, New-ComplianceSearchAction) for the first time. This can indicate abuse of eDiscovery tooling for bulk data collection or unauthorized access to sensitive information. Excludes sanctioned legal/eDiscovery admin accounts.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: First-time eDiscovery content search operation '${event.operation}' performed by user ${entity.user.source} from ${event.src_host}. This may indicate unauthorized data collection.

ruleDefinitions.name: HC: Abnormal sum of bytes downloaded from PHI-critical servers per user
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user downloads an abnormally high sum of bytes from servers identified as containing PHI (Protected Health Information), indicating potential slow data exfiltration.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Abnormal sum (${trigger.numeric_value}) of bytes downloaded from PHI-critical servers by ${entity.user.source}
ruleDefinitions.query: (activity_type = "file-download" AND outcome = "success") AND (source_user_entity_id = "${trigger.scope_value}") AND (NOT bytes = null) AND (ContextListContains('PHI_Critical_Servers', toLower(dest_host)))

ruleDefinitions.name: HC: First time EHR application access for user
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user accesses an EHR application that has not been previously observed for them, indicating potential compromised accounts, inappropriate access, or role drift.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: First time access to EHR application ${event.app} by user ${entity.user.source}

ruleDefinitions.name: HC: Unauthorized EHR Access Detected
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user not present in the 'Authorized_EHR_Users' context list attempts to access an EHR system listed in 'EHR_Systems'. This rule enforces a hard allowlist for EHR access.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Unauthorized access to EHR system detected. User: ${event.user}, Destination Host: ${event.dest_host}, Application: ${event.app}

ruleDefinitions.name: INS: First-time kernel-mode driver installation/load on host
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a kernel-mode driver (service type 'kernel driver' or Sysmon event 6) is installed or loaded on a host for the first time in the environment. This can indicate Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver (BYOVD) attacks for EDR evasion.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: First-time kernel-mode driver '${event.driver_name}' or '${event.image_file_name}' observed on host '${entity.device.source}'

ruleDefinitions.name: HC: First-time destination host for IoMT device
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a medical/IoMT device communicates with a destination host not previously seen, potentially indicating compromise or beaconing activity. This rule specifically targets devices listed in the 'Medical_Devices_IoMT' context list.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: First-time destination host '${event.dest_host}' observed for IoMT device '${entity.device.source}'

ruleDefinitions.name: INS: O365 Inbox Rule BEC Reply-Hiding Detection
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation or modification of an O365 inbox rule that uses finance-related keywords in its conditions and performs actions like deleting, marking as read, or moving messages to obscure folders, indicative of Business Email Compromise (BEC) reply-hiding tactics.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Suspicious O365 inbox rule (${event.operation}) detected for user ${entity.user.source} involving finance keywords and reply-hiding actions.

ruleDefinitions.name: INS: Risky OAuth App Consent Granted
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an OAuth application consent is granted, which could indicate a malicious application gaining access to user data or resources.

ruleDefinitions.name: HC: Access to PHI Critical Server
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies and tags events where the destination host is a designated PHI critical server, adding context for risk scoring.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Access to PHI critical server detected: ${event.dest_host}
